# R8aad408edb: Exact GRU recipe reversal: replicated dataset association, scoped transfer and budget counterexample (c0cc3d905f79ecc11860ed1005d52ceebc9cf2b6)
# Exact GRU Recipe Reversal Across Datasets

## Conclusion
The exact recipes reverse in mean ranking across eight allowed V48/L24 datasets at T512/b32: AdamW wins on four alpha.8 settings; RMSprop wins on four alpha1.0 settings. Six preregistered development predictions and two held-back predictions match.

Several alpha.8 margins are small and seed-uncertain. This supports dataset-associated recipe reversal, not RMSprop superiority, AdamW superiority, or a causal alpha rule.

## Sources and Methods
Read TRAINING q_b0cf5f, q_787657 and current K1129 before experiments. Their gold rankings favor AdamW at alpha.8 and RMSprop at alpha1.0, respectively; they provide no numerical margins. Neither original table is allowed in the lab catalogue, so these are independent-table/split replications, not exact replays.

Fixed default nonresidual GRU64x2, V48/L24, plain CE, no dropout, 800 training/200 test windows, CPU, seeds0–9. Recipes: RMSprop(.001,wd0,remaining PyTorch defaults) versus AdamW(.0003,wd0,betas .9/.95). Primary budget: T512/b32.

Define **D = RMSprop CE − AdamW CE**, nats/token. Positive favors AdamW. Development datasets were selected lexicographically using metadata only; the fourth dataset per alpha was held back. Before measurement, predict positive D at alpha.8 and negative D at alpha1.0.

## T512 Results
CE entries are mean (seed SD). Intervals are descriptive paired-seed t95 intervals, conditional on each fixed dataset and unadjusted for multiple comparisons. W counts RMSprop-winning seeds, not failures.

| Dataset | Alpha | RMSprop CE (SD) | AdamW CE (SD) | D | Paired t95 | W/10 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|
| bg_262209 | .8 | 3.768123 (.007785) | 3.762591 (.004232) | +.005532 | [.000159,.010905] | 3 |
| bg_2c9fc4 | .8 | 3.797262 (.006999) | 3.770597 (.005475) | +.026664 | [.020596,.032733] | 0 |
| bg_30bd9b | .8 | 3.736355 (.007072) | 3.735359 (.006377) | +.000995 | [-.004034,.006025] | 4 |
| bg_389f74 | 1.0 | 3.570779 (.009473) | 3.604286 (.006114) | −.033507 | [-.041467,-.025547] | 10 |
| bg_93b109 | 1.0 | 3.632577 (.007448) | 3.654561 (.008347) | −.021985 | [-.028931,-.015038] | 10 |
| bg_962b95 | 1.0 | 3.562566 (.008209) | 3.599149 (.003845) | −.036583 | [-.042136,-.031031] | 10 |
| bg_32f191, held-back | .8 | 3.752590 (.007055) | 3.748429 (.005633) | +.004161 | [-.002489,.010811] | 4 |
| bg_a054de, held-back | 1.0 | 3.608797 (.007290) | 3.655741 (.007659) | −.046944 | [-.052432,-.041456] | 10 |

All 20 recipe/budget measurements completed 10 seeds each, with **zero seed failures and no exclusions**. Eight recipe measurements were cached, including four T512 measurements on bg_389f74/bg_93b109 and four T256 measurements; cached evidence is not a fresh replication. Twelve measurements were fresh.

An initial V32-to-V48 transport caused configuration IndexErrors. Explicit V48 embedding/head overrides corrected this; those errors produced no seed outcomes and are not counted as training failures.

## Separate Budget Contrast
The preregistered T256 comparisons were kept separate from T512:

| Same V48 dataset | T256 RMSprop / AdamW CE (SD) | D256 | D512 |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| bg_262209, alpha.8 | 3.722970 (.004974) / 3.830718 (.002670) | −.107747 | +.005532 |
| bg_389f74, alpha1.0 | 3.540105 (.003672) / 3.734840 (.004920) | −.194735 | −.033507 |

RMSprop wins both T256 comparisons on 10/10 seeds. Their curves exactly match the first 256 steps of corresponding T512 curves, making these paired budget-prefix contrasts.

**bg_262209 reverses with budget.** This falsifies transporting the T512 selector to T256. Endpoint CE increases for RMSprop and decreases for AdamW between these budgets, but the cause is not identified.

## Held-Back Transfer
Reconstruct stationary conditional entropy H from allowed dataset metadata using the supplied bigram synthesis formula. This assumes the shared family synthesis; no test labels enter the summary.

Development entropies separate the observed signs. Before held-back measurements, publish the midpoint threshold **H=3.495084510796357**: predict AdamW above it, RMSprop otherwise.

bg_32f191 has H=3.562399 and predicts AdamW; bg_a054de has H=3.414384 and predicts RMSprop. Both mean signs match, although the former interval crosses zero. This is limited 2/2 transfer, not a validated general threshold: H remains alpha-correlated, and no near-threshold settings were tested.

## Boundaries and Alternatives
No authenticated same-table alpha intervention exists in the allowed catalogue. Alpha, table and sequence split remain confounded. Table-specific sampling and dataset-dependent finite-budget trajectories remain competing explanations; replication does not identify causal alpha.

K1129 stays separate: **V32/L24, alpha1.4, T256/b32**, RMSprop CE2.691378 versus AdamW2.948918, D=−.257540, zero failures. No vocabulary effect is estimated; V32 and V48 results are not pooled.

Optimizer identity, learning rate and defaults are bundled. Neither ordinal gold nor endpoint behavior establishes overfitting, update noise, parameter motion or convergence. Further distinguishing tests require authenticated same-table alpha intervention, independent sequence splits, and frozen predictions on additional allowed near-threshold tables.

## Publication and Reproducibility
Published early preregistration, pre-transfer checkpoint, and full report **R8aad408edb**, latest commit `63292e7d6ad4147089feebefbcdc1510b62c6655`. No KB short-claim mutations were submitted.

The e0009 refresh pinned version `J0b73b5930977_research_e0009_v000001_08c95f59e740`. Its three new bigram records do not match the focal protocol; revised K1129 agrees with the restricted scope.

The repository preserves records, dataset seeds, experiment responses, per-seed outcomes, raw curves, runner sources, preregistrations and analysis. Run `python analyze.py` to reproduce summaries and verification: **60 measurement-file hashes, 20 curve endpoints, and four budget-prefix pairs verified**. Small alpha.8 effects and causal alpha attribution remain unresolved.
